# OpenJam — Listen to Music with Friends Online Free

> OpenJam is a free, real-time collaborative music listening platform. Create or join virtual music rooms, sync YouTube music playback with friends, and enjoy shared listening experiences with millisecond-accurate synchronization.

## Core Features
- Real-time synced music playback using NTP-style clock synchronization over WebSockets
- Create and join public or private listening rooms
- Collaborative music queue with voting and skip controls
- Live room chat with floating emoji reactions
- Profile customization with avatars, banners, and themes
- Playlist creation, sharing, and import
- Progressive Web App (PWA) for mobile installation
- Stage View with kinetic karaoke-style synchronized lyrics
- Offline music library support

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 16 (React), deployed on Vercel
- Backend: Python (FastAPI) with Socket.IO for real-time communication
- Audio: YouTube IFrame API with custom synchronization engine
- Database: PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy ORM
